description: This file declares the WhiteListedOriginDomainsList class, which manages a whitelist of origin domains in the WebKit browser context within the WebKitBrowser project. It includes type definitions, a singleton pattern for instantiation, and methods to add whitelist data to WebKit.

classes.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList
classes.description: Manages a list of whitelisted origin domains, providing functionality to request the list from WPEFramework and to add whitelist configurations to WebKit.

methods.name: RequestFromWPEFramework
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a WhiteListedOriginDomainsList, optionally initialized with a provided whitelist string.

methods.name: AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the current whitelist to the WebKit bundle reference.
